To assess generalization beyond the LargeST benchmarks, we additionally evaluate FaST on the Electricity (power demand) dataset, which contains 321 variables sampled at 1-hour intervals over 2012–2014. The dataset comprises 8.38M–8.43M samples with mean 2,538.79 and standard deviation 15,027.57.
